create.name: Lama Lhanang Rinpoche
create.bio:
Lama Lhanang Rinpoche is a Tibetan teacher of Vajrayana Buddhism in the Nyingma school's Longchen Nyingthig lineage. Born in Golok in north-eastern Tibet, he entered Thubten Chokor Ling Monastery as a child, where his root teacher Kyabje Orgyen Kusum Lingpa gave him a full monastic education and training in the yogic lineage of Anu Yoga. A monastery in eastern Tibet recognised him as a reincarnate lama, and he has studied with many masters, among them the Dalai Lama and the fourth Dodrupchen Rinpoche. Alongside Buddhist study he learnt Tibetan history, astrology, grammar, painting, sculpture, music and theatre.

He is the spiritual teacher of the Jigme Lingpa Center, a non-profit he inspired, which holds weekly practice in San Diego, on Zoom and in Tijuana, has affiliated groups in North America, Europe and Asia, and organises retreats across North America. His teaching is practical and warm, summed up in the phrase world peace through inner peace, and covers meditation, Anu Yoga, mantra and the Tibetan view of living and dying. He leads a meditation teacher training, and with his student Mordy Levine he has written accessible books on Buddhism, karma and the Tibetan Book of the Dead.

books.title: The Tibetan Book of the Dead for Beginners: A Guide to Living and Dying
books.author: Lama Lhanang Rinpoche and Mordy Levine
books.description: An introduction to the teachings behind the Tibetan Book of the Dead, written with Mordy Levine. It covers karma, impermanence and the bardos, with practices for living well and for meeting death, one's own or a loved one's, with less fear.

books.title: The Beginner's Guide to Karma
books.author: Lama Lhanang Rinpoche and Mordy Levine
books.description: A plain-language look at karma in Buddhist thought, setting aside popular myths and showing how actions, words and thoughts shape experience, with practices for building good karma.

books.title: The Buddha in You
books.author: Lama Lhanang Rinpoche and Mordy Levine
books.description: A beginner's introduction to the main ideas of Buddhism in short chapters, each with a reflection, practice or meditation to try in daily life.

courses.title: Meditation Teacher Training Program with Lama Lhanang
courses.description: A training led by Lama Lhanang for students who want to teach meditation, covering how to present vipassana and shamatha practice to beginners and answer their questions, with practice teaching. It ends with a certificate and asks for a daily meditation practice throughout.

courses.title: Buddhist Kit for Living & Dying
courses.description: A boxed collection of written and recorded prayers, poems and readings, including his reading of the phowa practice, with his artwork and a small preloaded audio player.
courses.price: $45 (local pickup); $50 with US shipping; $65 shipped to Canada

free_resources.title: Weekly Classes and Practice
free_resources.description: Free weekly classes and practice sessions with the Jigme Lingpa Center, held in person in San Diego on Sundays and on Zoom. The Zoom link is sent on request by email.
